text:
anna liu: Hey quick question — do our request debug logs for request-ingest ever include customer emails or full request bodies? Need to know for a deletion/retention ask.

raj patel: Short answer: we try to redact tokens and passwords. Not sure about emails. Which logs? service name?

anna liu: request-ingest (prod). Example log: ```INFO request-ingest: received request {user_id: 4823, email: "alice@example.com", prompt: "Summarize..."}```

maria gonzalez: Flagging: PII in plain text is a no. Per policy, logs should mask emails and full request bodies. Default retention: logs 90 days, traces 30 days, ephemeral caches 7–14 days depending on tier. If that line exists we need to redact and backfill removal for affected files. :warning:

oliver kim: For immediate remediation open OPS ticket with the sample log and last_message_ts. I'll queue a job to rotate/redact and run s3 lifecycle if it's in object storage. Ops ticket template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa

sre-bot: Reminder — automated retention jobs run daily at 02:00 UTC. Deleted objects move to pending deletion for 48h.

anna liu: Thanks. Is there a quick grep+sed we can run to check how many occurrences? Example I ran: ```grep -R "email:\"@example.com\"" /var/log/request-ingest | wc -l``` but want a safer pattern.

maria gonzalez: Use regex to catch emails: ```grep -E -R "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" /var/log/request-ingest | head``` Once you have samples file a DSR or deletion request to privacy@redwood.com. Include customer id, approximate timestamps, and the s3 paths if present.

raj patel: Regarding KV caches: kv-prod (redis) uses TTLs 14 days for hosted, dedicated can be longer. Snapshots/backups stored in s3-retain can be 180 days. If you need deletion we have to expunge snapshots too.

maria gonzalez: Correct. For customer-initiated deletion follow the DSR runbook: include customer email, any identifiers, and whether data exists in logs/traces/caches/backups. Privacy will coordinate with Ops to rotate keys and purge. Turnaround is usually 2–5 business days.

oliver kim: I'll create OPS-3210 and tag @maria and @anna. Will kick off a redact job for request-ingest logs and schedule a snapshot deletion window. :thumbsup:

anna liu: Appreciate it. One last thing — traces: are traces sampled and do they contain full request? If yes we need to scrub spans.

raj patel: Jaeger traces keep full payload in rare cases when debug flag set. Default is to not persist request bodies, but i've seen a config that toggles it. Check `tracing.conf` for `capture_payloads = true`.

maria gonzalez: If capture_payloads=true, flip to false and rotate the collector. Also include that change in the change log and notify customer if data exposed. I'll handle DSR after ops flags which files to purge. :eyes:

anna liu: Thanks everyone — I'll open the DSR and add sample lines and customer id. Ping here when OPS-3210 exists.
